summary: A skipped test still reports green, so a runner without yaml, git or make would silently run fewer tests. With TACHIKOMA_STRICT_DEPS=1 these now fail instead of skipping: missing yaml (WorkflowPolicyTests), a missing git binary (SourceReleaseTests, ReleasePackageDataTests, RepositoryReleaseSelectionTests), a missing PvP shim in tests/test_pvp_safety.py, and missing make or git in tests/test_build_hygiene.py. A test that does not apply still skips: RepositoryReleaseSelectionTests when only .git is missing, and the build hygiene classes on a non-POSIX host, without the Makefile, or outside this checkout. Unset (or any value but 1), every decorator is plain unittest.skipUnless and behaviour is unchanged.  tests/test_strict_mode.py holds skip_unless_dependency and simulates each case with unittest.mock.patch, loading fresh copies of the affected modules so their import-time decorators see the patched environment. Built by a B0 subagent in an isolated worktree, stacked with the other dispatch-gated B0 slices on preview/b0-stack; re-validated by the parent agent.
